name: Herb Search — suggestion chip runs a search

planSteps.description: Click the suggestion chip 'herbs for digestion'

The empty-state panel below the search bar (its 'Welcome to the Herbary' heading and the suggestion chips) has been replaced by the results list. The 'The Herbary' site title in the page header is separate and is expected to stay visible
The text 'N herbs found' is visible, where N is greater than 0
At least one herb card with a '% match' badge is shown
